('TOB-2024-MOLP-DEFENSE', 'article', 'High-quality assembled and annotated genomes of Nicotiana tabacum and Nicotiana benthamiana reveal chromosome evolution and changes in defense arsenals', 'Wang, J. and Zhang, Q. and Tung, J. and others', 2024, 'Molecular Plant', '10.1016/j.molp.2024.01.008', 'https://www.cell.com/molecular-plant/fulltext/S1674-2052(24)00008-X', 'Pour lier génomique ↔ immunité ↔ stress (utile à axe dérive olfactive / climat).', '["tobacco","nicotiana","genome-assembly","annotation","defense"]', 'N1', '["M1"]', 'unread', 70, 'v4'),
